cases.prompt: A support queue needs retry, cancellation, and a human checkpoint. Recommend the smallest execution shape and explain what would justify a more complex one.

A research assistant may draft actions but must never send them. Design the ownership and permission boundary for drafting, approval, and execution.
A document intake process is currently sequential. Decide whether branching coordination is necessary, and name the evidence that would support escalation.
Three independent specialists need a single source of task state while a coordinator can resume after failure. Propose the control architecture and recovery checkpoints.
A classifier keeps making the same routing mistake. Decide whether the correction belongs in a permission, deterministic rule, task context, or topology change.
The request says make the onboarding flow robust. Turn that into a bounded deliverable, explicit non-goals, and observable completion evidence.
Define what work may proceed under reversible assumptions and what must pause for a decision before changing a customer billing export.
A team asks to modernize an import path with no stated compatibility window. Establish scope, exclusions, owners, and the information that would change the plan.
A designer and implementer disagree on what counts as done for a searchable table. Write a handoff contract with outcomes, constraints, and evidence.
Plan a local refactor requested as quick and safe when the repository has uncommitted work. Identify constraints, anti-goals, and escalation boundaries.
A manager wants a polished analytics page by Friday but has not named its users or decisions. Specify the smallest question set and a reversible first slice.
A duplicate notification appears only when two workers finish together. Select a proof strategy that can detect the race and define the claim it supports.
A revised checkout form passes component tests but may block keyboard completion in a real browser. Choose the smallest credible evidence portfolio.
A data conversion preserves row count but might alter currency rounding. Define the oracle, representative fixtures, and evidence freshness needed for this change.
A reported API defect cannot be reproduced on the current revision. Decide how to establish the current behavior and when no code change is the right result.
A third-party adapter is mocked in tests and handles account deletion. Specify the real-boundary check and what mock evidence cannot establish.
The source tests passed before packaging, but the delivered command now fails on a clean machine. Set the verification surface, artifact identity, and rerun rule.
Several deployments show the same timeout after a new retry setting. Turn the observation into a bounded change decision with competing explanations and a holdout check.
One operator reports that a generated summary was misleading, with no reproduction or comparison data. Decide whether to adopt a durable rule, hold, or record no change.
A release checklist was adopted six months ago, but recent evidence suggests one step creates delay without catching defects. Design the supersession decision and invalidation trigger.
A new instruction improves visible benchmark scores but users report no change. Propose a minimal experiment that checks the mechanism and guards against gaming.
Two teams use the same workaround for a failing handoff, but their environments differ. Determine the evidence class, operating envelope, and smallest possible intervention.
A local safeguard appears effective in one project. Define what provenance, counterevidence, owner, expiry, and rollback are needed before it becomes a shared practice.

An existing scheduling rule causes repeat cancellations in multiple regions. Decide how to govern the observed pattern before proposing a replacement rule.
A new durable queue will coordinate approval work across restarts. Define both the state-and-effect design and the evidence needed to prove recovery behavior.
A team must replace an export format before a partner deadline. Define the decision boundary and the verification evidence for backward compatibility.
